item.text: The parser already maps the basic references, timestamps, type, and fix version, but it emits one record per CVE reference and drops the enriched summary, PoC, introduced version, and CVSS data. I’m checking the model’s existing optional and CVSS fields so the enrichment fits the established record format.

The parser now keeps the first CVE identifier, populates the existing summary/CVSS fields, stores PoC and introduced-version values in optional metadata, and normalizes timestamps to UTC. The detector package tests pass; I’m updating the checkpoint with the completed work.
